# Load amrsearch data
```{r}
amrsearch_data <- list.files(path = "./data/amrsearch_10_20_2026_probes/",pattern = "jsn",full.names = T)

results <- pbmcapply::pbmclapply(amrsearch_data,get_amrsearch_data,mc.cores = 5)

resistance_profiles <- lapply(results,FUN=function(x){x$resistance_profile}) %>% do.call(rbind,.)
gene_mutation_profile <- lapply(results,FUN=function(x){x$genotype_profile })  %>% do.call(bind_rows,.)
saveRDS(gene_mutation_profile,"./data/amrsearch_10_20_2026_probes/amrsearch_10_20_2026_probes_master_gene_data.RDS")
gene_profile <- gene_mutation_profile %>% subset(entry == 'gene')
mutation_profile <- gene_mutation_profile %>% subset(entry == 'variant') 
```

# Resistance profiles
```{r}
resistance_wide <- resistance_profiles %>%
  select(isolate, antibiotic, state) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = antibiotic, values_from = state) %>%
  select(isolate, sort(colnames(.)[-1]))

gene_wide <- gene_profile %>%
  select(isolate, refId) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(present = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = refId, values_from = present, values_fill = 0) %>%
  select(isolate, sort(colnames(.)[-1]))

mutation_wide <- mutation_profile %>%
  select(isolate, genotype_name) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(present = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = genotype_name, values_from = present, values_fill = 0)  %>%
  select(isolate, sort(colnames(.)[-1]))

amrsearch_matrix <- left_join(resistance_wide,gene_wide) %>% left_join(.,mutation_wide)

saveRDS(amrsearch_matrix,"./data/amrsearch_10_20_2026_probes/amrsearch_10_20_2026_probes_master_matrix.RDS")
```
